title: Balanced and Unbalanced Forces
seo_title: Grade 7 Science: Balanced and Unbalanced Forces Worksheets (MATATAG)
standard_code: Grade 7, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy
standard_text: Forces are pushes or pulls; contact and non-contact forces; balanced forces do not change motion, while unbalanced forces change speed or direction; weight and mass; friction. (summary of the MATATAG Science curriculum, Grade 7, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy)
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 Science worksheets (MATATAG, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy): contact and field forces, effects of forces, balanced and unbalanced forces, weight and mass and friction. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

A force is a push or a pull, measured in newtons (N) with a spring scale. Contact forces act when objects touch (friction, tension, applied force). Field forces act at a distance (gravity, magnetic and electrostatic forces).

Weight is the force of gravity on a mass: W = mg, with g = 9,8 N·kg⁻¹ on Earth. Balanced forces cancel out, so the motion does not change; unbalanced forces make an object speed up, slow down or change direction.

Example

Is magnetism a contact force or a field force?

Magnets act without touching.

Answer: a field force

Example

What is the weight of a 10 kg bag on Earth?

W = mg

Answer: 98 N

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up mass (kg) and weight (N).
  • Thinking a moving object needs a force to keep moving.
  • Thinking gravity only acts on falling objects.
